asset.name: ArtifactCard
asset.description: The generated-output component with type-specific preview, version, status, and actions to edit, open, compare, export, download, and inspect provenance.

requires.reason: Framing uses the shared card, which is a genuinely bounded object here.
Certainty and urgency are expressed on the shared orthogonal axes rather than as one flat variant set.
Type treatment and placeholder handling are shared.
Timestamps render and update through the shared component.

suggests.reason: Artifacts that represent proposed changes need review; finished outputs do not.
